_schema: Vireio Perception supported-games catalogue. Each entry generates a data/games/<slug>.json with a `type: "vireio"` stereo fix entry. The fix carries a `vireio_workspace` filename — at install time, modules/adapters/vireio.js spawns Inicio with `--workspace Profiles/<file>.aqu --target <exe>` so the engine auto-loads. Vireio's head-tracking output is independently available as an HT Fix option for any stereo mod (see renderer.js DETECTED_HARDWARE_TO_DISPLAY + the 'vireio' method in updateHeadtrackingUI).

half-life-2.title: Half-Life 2
half-life-2.notes: Source engine. DX9 path. Run with -dxlevel 90 launch option for stability.
issues: Some bumpmaps render at screen depth.

skyrim-special-edition.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
skyrim-special-edition.notes: Creation Engine DX11 path. Disable Skyrim's own borderless windowed mode.

mirrors-edge.title: Mirror's Edge
mirrors-edge.notes: UE3. PhysX cloth/water can break in stereo — disable PhysX advanced effects.

bioshock-infinite.title: BioShock Infinite
bioshock-infinite.notes: UE3 DX11. Tested against the standard Steam release — the Remastered (Complete Edition) build also works.

borderlands-2.title: Borderlands 2
borderlands-2.notes: UE3 cel-shaded. Disable in-game DOF/AO for cleaner depth.
